evals.name: Service Unit Test Isolation & Mocked Dependency Injection
evals.prompt: Author an isolated unit test spec for a NestJS domain service using Vitest, mocking external repository calls and verifying exception throwing.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds colocated user.service.spec.ts with mock repository provider, tests happy path and NotFoundException, and cleans up mocks in beforeEach.
assertions: Colocates spec file alongside target service
Mocks external repository methods using vi.fn
Asserts domain exceptions on missing entities
Resets mock calls in beforeEach hook

evals.name: Code Coverage Gate & Threshold Enforcement
evals.prompt: Configure test coverage thresholds in Vitest requiring 80% line and 75% branch coverage and audit missing colocated spec files.
evals.expected_output: Defines coverage thresholds in vitest.config.ts and verifies that CI fails if coverage drops below 80% line or 75% branch boundaries.
assertions: Configures minimum 80% line coverage threshold in test config
Configures minimum 75% branch coverage threshold in test config
Identifies production source files lacking colocated spec tests
Fails build when test coverage drops below required thresholds

evals.name: Playwright E2E Test Suite & Resilient Locator Scaffolding
evals.prompt: Author a Playwright E2E test script automating user authentication and form submission using resilient locators and auto-waiting.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds e2e/auth.spec.ts utilizing getByRole, getByLabel, avoiding arbitrary sleeps, and verifying visual assertion states.
assertions: Uses accessible locators like getByRole and getByLabel instead of brittle CSS
Avoids arbitrary sleep or waitForTimeout delays
